---
title: "Guided Case Conversations - Schedule"
format: docx
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

here::i_am("handouts/conbio_case_studies/case_convo_schedule.qmd")
source(here::here("_common.R"))
course_short <- "conbio"
semester     <- "26s"

library(kableExtra)

load(here("conbio/schedule_data.RData"))

case_convo_schedule <- filter(schedule_data, str_detect(agenda, "Case Conversation")) %>%
  mutate(Date = as_date(Date)) %>%
  mutate(Date = format(Date, "%a %b %d")) %>%
  select(
    Date,
    topic
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Name 1` = "              ",
    `Name 2` = "              ",
    `Name 3` = "              ",
    `Name 4` = "              "
  )
```

```{r}
#| column: screen

kable(case_convo_schedule)
```
